{{Quote|The Republic military brings more than conflict, I assure you. I am far more interested in using this might to fortify the future than wage war in the present.|Jedi Master Bolla Ropal|<ref name="AoI" />}}
'''Bolla Ropal''' {{C|{{Audio|BollaRopal-HH.flac|Pronunciation}}}} was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who lived in the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ropal acted as the keeper of the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]], a [[Memory crystal/Legends|device]] that contained the names of all known [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Around the beginning of the war, the Rodian accompanied several other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Masters and members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to a meeting with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] regarding the kidnapping of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Rotta/Legends|son]] by agents of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Later in the war, Ropal and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Tyzen Xebec]], oversaw the construction of the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]], a Republic base on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]].

During a meeting between Ropal and several [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Politics/Legends|dignitaries]], Devaron was [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|invaded]] by Confederate forces under the command of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]. Under the directive of his client, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, Bane hunted down Ropal in order to retrieve the Kyber [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] and unlock the information it held. Ropal was defeated during the battle and taken to [[Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Bane's ''Munificent''-class frigate]], where he was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]]. Learning of Bane's plot to steal the crystal, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] led a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to Devaron to engage the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter and rescue Ropal before the Confederate forces fled [[Devaron system/Legends|the system]]. Short on [[Time/Legends|time]], Bane increased Ropal's torture while repeatedly trying to force the Jedi Master to unlock the secrets of the crystal. Ropal continually refused, and the torture eventually resulted in his [[Death/Legends|death]]. The Jedi Master's body was discovered shortly thereafter by Republic forces and moved to the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']].

==Biography==
===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Who is Bolla Ropal?''"<br />"''He is the keeper of the Kyber crystal.|Anakin Skywalker and Mace Windu|audio=KeeperOfTheKyberCrystal-HH.flac|<ref name="holo" />}}
[[File:RopalAndDevaronians-TCWs02i01p01.png|thumb|left|220px|Master Ropal meets with Devaronian officials.]]
Bolla Ropal was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]<ref name="SWE"/> who served as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[Great Peace of the Republic|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TCWn" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|Hailing]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], he<ref name="holo" /> eventually rose to the level of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and took the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Tyzen Xebec]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]].<ref name="AoI" /> As a Master, Ropal was given the duty to protect and preserve the information within the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]], a [[Memory crystal/Legends|device]] that held the identities of all known [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. This information would then be used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to find new children to initiate into their ranks.<ref name="holo" /> Ropal visited at least one of these younglings, [[Wee Dunn/Legends|Wee Dunn]], in Rodia's [[Kay-Tap square/Legends|Kay-Tap square]]. After witnessing the child's strong connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Ropal confirmed that he would eventually be taken by the Jedi Order but reassured the infant's mother, [[Mahtee Dunn/Legends|Mahtee Dunn]], that this would not happen for quite some time.<ref name="CoF">{{TCW|Children of the Force}}</ref> Ropal also had a keen interest in [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]]<ref name="TCWCE" />&mdash;repositories of Force information and history.<ref name="JvS:EGF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> Over his lifetime, the Jedi Master studied many of these devices.<ref name="TCWCE" />

With the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Ropal joined his fellow Jedi in becoming a [[Jedi General/Legends|general]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="AoI" /> Shortly after the beginning of the conflict, he accompanied Jedi Masters [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], and [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] to a meeting with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|the Chancellor's office]] in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]]. The Chancellor had been contacted by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] following the kidnapping of his son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], and had agreed to send Jedi to aid in the investigation, despite reservations voiced by Windu and Unduli. Rotta was eventually [[Battle of Teth/Legends|found]] and [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends|returned]] to Jabba by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his Padawan, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].<ref name="TCWn" />

Later in the war, Ropal and Xebec led a contingent of the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]] to [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]], a world in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region that had recently consented to allow the Republic to build<ref name="AoI" /> the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]],<ref name="Complete Season Two">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]], Blu-ray edition</ref> a base on their planet. Not wanting his men to sit idle within the base, Ropal put them to work on several non-combat tasks. Under his guidance, [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] serving with [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]]<ref name="AoI" /> [[Ganch]] of the [[612th Attack Battalion]],<ref name="Sideshow Ganch">{{SideshowCite|set=Militaries of Star Wars|packtype=Sixth Scale Figure|pack=Commander Ganch (612th Attack Battalion)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Commander_Ganch_Sideshow_Collectibles_Celebration_VI.asp}}</ref> undertook good-will projects for the native [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]], including the construction of a [[Dam/Legends|dam]] and the ecological restoration of a once-verdant valley. Ropal took a special interest in the valley, believing it to be symbolic of Devaron's future.<ref name="AoI" />

====Death over Devaron====
{{Quote|Simply open this little box of yours so I can get the information from this crystal and your suffering will come to an end.''"<br />"''You will&hellip;never&hellip;get me to&hellip;unlock the&hellip;holocron.''"<br />"''Unfortunately I don't have time to discuss this with you. Hit him again, full power.|Cad Bane and Bolla Ropal|audio=RopalTortured-CoD.flac|<ref name="CoD" />}}
[[File:BollaRopalDragged1-CoD.png|thumb|right|220px|Ropal is dragged off by battle droids on Devaron.]]
Meanwhile, [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious had hired [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to retrieve the information stored within Ropal's Kyber crystal. After [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|stealing]] a [[Jedi holocron/Legends|holocron]] from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]],<ref name="holo" /> Bane was loaned a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] to take to Devaron.<ref name="CoD" /> Although the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] had learned of Bane's plans, they were unable to contact Ropal and warn him, as he had become out-of-contact in the [[Devaron system/Legends|Devaron system]].<ref name="holo" /> During a meeting between Ropal and two Devaronian [[minister]]s, one [[Unidentified male Devaronian minister|male]] and one [[Unidentified female Devaronian minister|female]], concerning the progress of the Republic projects, Bane's armada [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|invaded]] the planet. The [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter's forces flooded into the valley where the Republic army was stationed and quickly overpowered Ropal's [[Troop/Legends|troops]], despite the efforts of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Ganch and his soldiers. Taken by surprise, Ropal understood that the battle was lost and ordered Xebec to stay out of the valley.<ref name="AoI" />

Bane dispatched fellow bounty hunter [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] to lead a [[Nashtah Team|squad]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to locate Ropal and report his location to the Duros so he could move in and capture the Jedi. Sing's team sighted Ropal near the eastern wall of the valley and shot down a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Republic gunship]] to distract him and his forces from Bane's arrival on the battlefield. Upon landing on the surface of the planet, Bane engaged the Jedi Master in combat, firing at him with [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] bullets that shorted out Ropal's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Bane then bound Ropal's legs with a [[Fibercord whip/Legends|fibercord whip]] and pulled him to the ground. After Bane revealed the stolen holocron and demanded that Ropal aid him in opening it, the Rodian refused and threw aside his lightsaber. Ropal was then rendered unconscious by an electrical shock from a [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droid]] and taken [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by Bane.<ref name="AoI" />

[[File:Ropal_tortured.png|thumb|left|250px|Ropal is tortured shortly before his death.]]
Stripped of the Kyber crystal, the unconscious Ropal was taken by a pair of super battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class shuttle]] before being ferried up to [[Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Bane's ''Munificent''-class frigate]]. Ropal was dragged to the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|ship's]] [[Prison/Legends|cell]] blocks and placed within a [[Containment field/Legends|magnetic containment field]]. After Ropal was jabbed in the chest by a [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuard's]] [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]], the battle droid overseeing Ropal's interrogation instructed the barely conscious Rodian that he was to remain awake until Bane had arrived. While waiting, Ropal's droid captors attached [[Mind limiter/Legends|mind limiters]] and [[Pain pulser/Legends|pain pulsers]] to his body and injected him with a full dose of the drug [[X-C33/Legends|X-C33]].<ref name="CoD" />

As Bane's armada prepared to depart Devaron, Anakin Skywalker led a fleet of Republic warships into the [[Star system/Legends|system]] in order to prevent Bane's escape. Skywalker's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], fired upon the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] engines of Bane's [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], preventing it from fleeing to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Recognizing that he had little time before Skywalker and his forces boarded the frigate, Bane demanded that Ropal assist him in opening the holocron he had stolen from the Jedi Temple. With the holocron open, Bane would be able to insert the Kyber crystal and access the information it stored.<ref name="CoD" /> However, Ropal refused Bane's demands, as he sensed that the bounty hunter was working on behalf of a greater evil,<ref name="TCWCE" /> and so was electrocuted several times more. After one final refusal from Ropal, Bane ordered the [[Unidentified B1-series battle droid (Cad Bane's frigate)/Legends|battle droid]] overseeing the [[Torture/Legends|torture]] to electrocute the Jedi at full power. Ropal [[Death/Legends|died]], and his limp body was dropped to the floor. He was later discovered by Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano, and moved from the Confederate frigate to the ''Resolute''.<ref name="CoD" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|I am sorry for your loss, Padawan Tyzen. Look to the Force for strength and know that Bolla Ropal died in service to the Order.|Mace Windu, to Tyzen Xebec|<ref name="AoI" />}}
[[File:BollaRopalDead-CoD.png|thumb|right|230px|Ropal's body, as discovered by Republic forces.]]
Because of Ropal's refusal to comply with his orders, Bane was forced to seek another Jedi to aid him in accessing the Kyber crystal's information. He was eventually able to trap Tano on the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielded]] [[Realspace/Legends|spaceward]] side of an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] aboard the Confederate frigate. Under the threat of having his apprentice jettisoned into the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of space, Skywalker opened the holocron for Bane&mdash;doing exactly what Ropal had sacrificed his life to avoid.<ref name="CoD" /> Bane escaped with the holocron and, under the orders of Darth Sidious, began collecting children from the list on the Kyber crystal. Bane eventually traveled to Rodia to [[Second mission to Rodia/Legends|capture]] Wee Dunn. Although Bane was masquerading as a Jedi, Mahtee Dunn was hesitant to relinquish her son, citing her earlier visit from Ropal and his assurances that the young Rodian would not be inducted into the Jedi Order for quite some time. Despite this, Bane escaped with Wee Dunn and took him to the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. The children whom Bane stole were later [[Mission to Mustafar (Skywalker and Tano)/Legends|rescued]] by Skywalker and Tano, and the holocron was [[Mission to Black Stall Station/Legends|recovered]] by Masters Windu and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="CoF" />

On Devaron, Xebec was left without a Master. The dam that Ropal had been working to construct was destroyed during Bane's assault on Devaron, flooding the valley that he had invested so much time on. Reflecting on his Master, Xebec surmised that Ropal was too focused on the future, and his unfinished work on the valley was representative of that flaw. The young Zabrak returned to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, where he was informed of his Master's death at Bane's hands by Windu. Xebec later ran into Tano, inquiring after her role in finding and rescuing Ropal. The distraught Xebec confided in Tano his anger with his Master's constant pacifism and what Xebec perceived to be an attitude of intellectual superiority. Xebec was later given a new Master, [[Keelyvine Reus]], who had difficulties training her new Padawan.<ref name="AoI" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|This valley&hellip; he called it the future, for the Devaronians. He spent so much time working on it. And he never saw it, Ganch.''"<br />"''Sir?''"<br />"''He never saw the present. And now he's gone.|Tyzen Xebec and Commander Ganch|<ref name="AoI" />}}
Bolla Ropal was a Rodian Jedi Master, who stood at 1.75 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall,<ref name="TCWCE" /> with iridescent [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and green skin.<ref name="CoD" /> He was a brave Jedi,<ref name="Cargo of Doom Dataclip">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a250596241505e20124163d3fcd0008|text=Dataclip: Cargo of Doom|na=video file}}</ref> and was highly concerned with the future welfare of the Republic and the Jedi Order.<ref name="AoI" /> In his position as the keeper of the Kyber crystal, Ropal was the protector of the information that ultimately represented the future generations of the Jedi Knights.<ref name="holo" /> As a [[General/Legends|general]] in the Grand Army of the Republic, Ropal used the troops under his command for goodwill projects that bolstered public opinion of the Republic. His belief that the Republic's [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] might could be good for something other than destruction and war manifested itself in his work in the valley on Devaron. Believing it to be representative of the future of the Devaronians, Ropal took its restoration as his personal pet project and spent much time working on it.<ref name="AoI" /> Ropal's dedication to the future kept him from giving into Cad Bane, despite the torture he experienced at the hands of the bounty hunter.<ref name="CoD" />

The Jedi Master understood that a hired gun such as Cad Bane was unlikely to come across knowledge of the Kyber crystal, as the artifact was one of the Jedi Order's most closely guarded secrets.<ref name="TCWCE" /> Indeed, there were even individuals within the Order itself who did not know of its existence until Ropal became a target of the Confederacy.<ref name="holo" /> Knowing the secrecy surrounding the crystal and its contents, Ropal correctly surmised that Bane was working on behalf of a far more dangerous enemy who could be a threat to the future of the Order. As such, the Jedi Master accepted torture and death in order to protect the secrets of the Jedi.<ref name="TCWCE" />

[[File:TyzenXebecAtBollaRopalsValley-ActOnInstinct.png|thumb|right|200px|Xebec reflects upon his Master's work.]]
Ropal cared deeply for his Padawan, Tyzen Xebec. During the invasion of Devaron, Ropal understood that the Republic base and valley were going to be overrun and thus ordered Xebec to stay away in the interest of his safety. Although Xebec wished to aid his Master, he obeyed his orders and remained with Commander Ganch during Ropal's abduction. In the aftermath of the battle, Xebec believed that his Master had been too focused on the future and was unable to see the present, a flaw that had cost him his life. The young Zabrak also lamented that his Master had not lived to see the completion of his work on Devaron.<ref name="AoI" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Not much of a fighter, are you Master Ropal?''"<br />"''The Force has many aspects and strengths, hunter.''"<br />"''Oh, I know ''all'' about your strengths, Ropal. You're a scholar. A ''seer''.|Cad Bane and Bolla Ropal|<ref name="AoI" />}}
Bolla Ropal was strong enough in the Force to reach the status of Jedi Master.<ref name="TCWn" /> Although the Rodian lacked combat ability and prowess with a lightsaber, he was talented in [[Force vision/Legends|predicting]] the future through the Force as a seer. His confidence in that power was shown to be misplaced when he was unable to foresee the invasion of Devaron.<ref name="AoI" /> Ropal also had a commendable knowledge of Jedi history.<ref name="TCWCE" />

When engaging Cad Bane, Ropal was quickly neutralized.<ref name="AoI" /> Despite his perceived weakness, the Jedi Master was able to withstand extended periods of torture that included electrocutions and poisoning.<ref name="CoD" /> On a dossier acquired by Bane regarding Ropal, his abilities were stated to be "in question," and his threat potential was listed as "minimal."<ref name="holo" /> 

==Equipment==
During the Clone Wars, Ropal carried a green-bladed lightsaber.<ref name="AoI" /> He was also the keeper of the Kyber memory crystal. Ropal's [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] consisted of an off-white [[Clothing/Legends|tunic]] and brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="CoD" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Well, Bolla Ropal meets a very sad ending in this episode, but I have to say, it is exactly what it should be.|Dave Filoni|<ref name="Video Commentary">{{SW|url=video/cargo-of-doom-episode-featurette|text="Cargo of Doom" Episode Featurette}}</ref>}}
[[File:Clonewars by karen.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Bolla Ropal first appeared in the novelization of the film ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars''.]]
The character Bolla Ropal was created for the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. His name was derived from an acronym of an assistant of [[Dave Filoni]], the series' supervising director.<ref name="Video Commentary" /> Ropal first appeared in [[Karen Traviss]]'s [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]],<ref name="TCW novel">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> which was released on [[July 26]], [[2008]].<ref name="TCW novel Date">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/young/news20080429.html|text=Penguin Group and DK Publishing to Publish ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Books}}</ref> In the novel, Ropal was present during Supreme Chancellor Palpatine's meeting with members of the Jedi High Council to discuss the kidnapping of Rotta the Hutt.<ref name="TCW novel" /> Ropal did not appear in the corresponding scene in the film, as the only Jedi present in Supreme Chancellor Palpatine's office were Mace Windu, Plo Koon, and Luminara Unduli.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

The character later appeared in "[[Cargo of Doom]]," the second episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of ''The Clone Wars'', which released on [[October 2]], [[2009]]. In the episode, he was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="Cargo of Doom Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode202.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cargo of Doom}}</ref> According to Filoni, Ropal's death was intentionally morbid, with the Jedi Master's death scene illustrating Cad Bane's ruthlessness, as the bounty hunter was to be the major villain of the initial Season Two story arc. In the episode's online commentary, Filoni also states that Ropal's defiance to Bane was needed in order to give more significance to the character's death, as the episode was the Rodian's first and only appearance in the television series.<ref name="Video Commentary" />
